race.comment: Tricky race to assess with a few of these facing the starter for the first time. Of the raced brigade RECONCILIATE (8) resumes here but showed ability when last in work and should find this company more to her liking. Revved up for this with two solid trials and trust that Gollan has her up to the mark. Expecting a strong run while fresh. SNITZSTREAM (9) strips fitter third-up from the spell and gets in well at the weights with the 2kg claim. No reason why she cannot find winning ways. ANDERLAY (3) is on debut but has shown plenty of ability at the trials and Sandkuhl stays on board for race day. Respect any market support. CASTELLA MAGIC (6) is another at the races for the first time but won't need to be a superstar to be competitive against this lot. In the mix.
